findings.description: Access key and secret key credentials are stored in plain text in the Lambda environment variables. These are readable by anyone with describe permissions on the resource and constitute long-lived static credentials exposed in the configuration.
The Lambda function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving the function vulnerable to known unpatched exploits.
